questions.question: How many employees work at the store?
questions.graph_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Employee

questions.question: What is the highest price of any track?
questions.graph_sql: SELECT MAX(UnitPrice) FROM Track LIMIT 5

questions.question: What is the average invoice total?
questions.graph_sql: SELECT AVG(Total) FROM Invoice

questions.question: How many tracks are in the Rock genre?
questions.graph_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Rock'

questions.question: How many albums does Iron Maiden have?
questions.graph_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Album JOIN Artist ON Album.ArtistId = Artist.ArtistId WHERE Artist.Name = 'Iron Maiden'

questions.question: How many albums does Metallica have?
questions.graph_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Album JOIN Artist ON Album.ArtistId = Artist.ArtistId WHERE Artist.Name = 'Metallica'

questions.question: What genre is the song Smells Like Teen Spirit?
questions.graph_sql: SELECT T1.Name FROM Genre AS T1 INNER JOIN Track AS T2 ON T1.GenreId = T2.GenreId WHERE T2.Name = 'Smells Like Teen Spirit' LIMIT 5

questions.question: How many tracks are in the Grunge playlist?
questions.graph_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PlaylistTrack PT JOIN Playlist P ON PT.PlaylistId = P.PlaylistId WHERE P.Name = 'Grunge'

questions.question: How many customers does Steve Johnson support?
questions.graph_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer c JOIN Employee e ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId WHERE e.FirstName = 'Steve' AND e.LastName = 'Johnson'

questions.question: How many Classical tracks are there?
questions.graph_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Classical';

questions.question: What is the total revenue from Germany?
questions.graph_sql: SELECT SUM(Invoice.Total) FROM Invoice JOIN Customer ON Invoice.CustomerId = Customer.CustomerId WHERE Customer.Country = 'Germany'

questions.question: How many Jazz tracks are longer than 6 minutes?
questions.graph_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Jazz' AND t.Milliseconds > 360000

questions.question: How many albums have more than 20 tracks?
questions.graph_sql: SELECT AlbumId FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId HAVING COUNT(*) > 20 LIMIT 5

questions.question: Which media type has the most tracks?
questions.graph_sql: SELECT MediaType.Name, COUNT(Track.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Track JOIN MediaType ON Track.MediaTypeId = MediaType.MediaTypeId GROUP BY MediaType.Name ORDER BY TrackCount DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: Who is the youngest employee?
questions.graph_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Employee ORDER BY BirthDate DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which composer wrote the most tracks?
questions.graph_sql: SELECT Composer FROM Track WHERE Composer IS NOT NULL GROUP BY Composer ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: Which customer has spent the most money?
questions.graph_sql: SELECT T1.CustomerId, T1.FirstName, T1.LastName, SUM(T2.Total) AS TotalSpent FROM Customer AS T1 INNER JOIN Invoice AS T2 ON T1.CustomerId = T2.CustomerId GROUP BY T1.CustomerId ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: Which country has the highest average invoice total?
questions.graph_sql: SELECT BillingCountry FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY AVG(Total) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many invoices were issued in 2024?
questions.graph_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2024'

questions.question: Which year had the highest total sales?
questions.graph_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS Year, SUM(Total) AS TotalSales FROM Invoice GROUP BY Year ORDER BY TotalSales DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: how many customers are from the united kingdom?
questions.graph_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'United Kingdom'

questions.question: how many tracks does led zeppelin have?
questions.graph_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track JOIN Album ON Track.AlbumId = Album.AlbumId JOIN Artist ON Album.ArtistId = Artist.ArtistId WHERE Artist.Name = 'Led Zeppelin'
